description: How Michael chooses which saved memories to read for a question. The Next.js server loads the caller's own memories (one user's, or one organization's, filtered in SQL by scope, expiry and sensitivity) and sends at most maxItems of them, each under a request-local ref and without any id. services/intelligence/app/memory/selection.py ranks them deterministically by word overlap with the question, rarer words counting more, newer memories first on a tie, and returns at most `limit` refs. With no question, or when nothing overlaps, it returns the newest. No model is called, and semantic retrieval is deferred until this is measured as insufficient.
